install_hints.Darwin: Install Python 3.11 or newer from python.org or with pyenv.
install_hints.Linux: Install Python 3.11 or newer with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install FFmpeg with `brew install ffmpeg` or another trusted package source.
install_hints.Linux: Install the ffmpeg package with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install the Xcode command-line tools or Git from a trusted package source.
install_hints.Linux: Install Git with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install current Node.js LTS from nodejs.org or with a version manager.
install_hints.Linux: Install current Node.js LTS from nodejs.org or with a version manager.

install_hints.Darwin: Install Graphviz with `brew install graphviz` when lineage or arrangement maps are wanted.
install_hints.Linux: Install the graphviz package with your distribution package manager.

install_hints.default: Run `make visuals-install` from the repository root.

install_hints.Darwin: Use an isolated ACE-Step 1.5 environment only after checking hardware: accelerated macOS packages require Apple Silicon; Intel Macs should use an explicitly operated remote sidecar or accept slow CPU inference.
install_hints.Linux: Use the official isolated ACE-Step 1.5 environment after checking GPU, VRAM, disk, model license, and output-rights requirements.

install_hints.Darwin: Install Audacity if hands-on recording or waveform editing is wanted.
Install Sonic Pi if live coding, MIDI, or local OSC performance is wanted.

workflows.label: Daily agent work
workflows.description: Claim due local work, prepare verified bounded context, and preserve result evidence without launching an agent.

workflows.label: Performed beat idea to reviewed groove
workflows.description: Observe a spoken or played beat without assigning roles, author one explicit drummer-facing interpretation, and audition it as a review-gated BeatScript prototype.

workflows.label: Optional local generative-music collaboration
workflows.description: Hand an owned prompt, lyrics, or reference recording to an explicitly operated local generator and return new audio plus exact model, seed, settings, rights, and listening evidence.

workflows.label: Source recording to lossless master
workflows.description: Preserve supplied performances, bind consequential decisions to exact evidence, develop reversibly, and create an approved lossless master.

workflows.label: DAW-neutral arrangement handoff
workflows.description: Export a verified working mix as common-start lossless float stems, then capture a declared lossless DAW return for review and mastering.

workflows.label: Promptable visual production
workflows.description: Develop and render local promptable visuals, then preserve renderer-neutral picture candidates for review.

workflows.label: Local YouTube release preparation
workflows.description: Prepare an approved master with either a title card or reviewed renderer-neutral picture, thumbnail/caption/chapter assets, a rights-aware FINAL package, and exact offline uploader inputs without uploading.

workflows.label: Local Spotify and Apple Music handoff
workflows.description: Prepare an approved lossless master, square artwork, credits, identifiers, and public-rights evidence for a separately authorized distributor submission.

workflows.label: Full local production
workflows.description: Run the complete local prompt-and-recordings-to-YouTube-handoff workflow, including recurring agent work and visuals.
